notes.title: Haunted House 2 is offically released
notes.content:
*Please note again that this game is not available in English yet, please consider carefully before purchasing.

Everyone has been waiting for a long time, and the release day has finally arrived, which has been really exciting for a while.
We put a lot of effort into creating this story. Although it may not satisfy everyone, we tried our best.

If you have any ideas or questions about the game, you are welcome to tell us. If you encounter any bugs, please let us know and we will fix them and update them immediately.

Thanks again to our friends for supporting us, I hope you all have a good time.

Several known issues are currently being fixed/fixed:
1. Autoplay sometimes doesn’t work very well, so it’s recommended not to press autoplay yet.
2. In the second quarter, Fan Yu’s vertical painting changed the safety buckle. (Changed)
3. The Mandarin dubbing has not been completed yet, and we will update it later.
4. There is a font misalignment issue in the exit interface. (Fixed)

notes.title: Haunted House 2 will be released soon
notes.content:
[b]Please note that the game is currently not available in English.
[/b]

Dear security guards~

Happy New Year! A belated blessing! I am Fu Zhen, the producer of Menggui Mansion.
Mansion 2 has entered the last few days of debugging and optimization. If nothing unexpected happens, it is scheduled to be released to you on February 14~
However, surprises usually come when there are no surprises. The latest version of the game is currently under review, and we hope that there will be no problems with it, otherwise it may really be postponed.

But even if it is postponed, it will only be postponed for two or three days at most, so security guards, please rest assured!

Ghost Mansion 2 is a game with a full Cantonese storyline. The story is set in Hong Kong public housing estates and tells the story of a security guard's experience of bumping into a ghost. In addition to continuing the story of the first generation and giving an ending to the protagonist Li Cheng, this work will also trace the secret of the birth of the braided girl in the 1950s.
